The '''Altier sector''' was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the astronomical objects [[Altier]], [[Gerhalt III]], and [[Trebela]], as well as the [[Ruugia system/Legends|Ruugia system]]. The [[Gerhalt system/Legends|Gerhalt system]] was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as early as [[17,000 BBY]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kraxith]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] broke up a major [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] network that was operating on Trebela.

==Description==
The Altier [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in<ref name="Expansion" /> [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Altier sector bordered the [[Hilo sector/Legends|Hilo]] and [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sectors]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the [[Surron sector/Legends|Surron sector]] [[spinward]], and the [[Kailion sector/Legends|Kailion]] and [[Narvath sector/Legends|Narvath sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction. [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the Altier sector also formed a four-way border with the [[Palamut sector/Legends|Palamut]], [[Tokamac sector/Legends|Tokamac]], and [[Venzeiia sector/Legends|Venzeiia sectors]].<ref name="Expansion" /> The Altier sector contained the [[Altier system/Legends|Altier]], [[Gerhalt system/Legends|Gerhalt]], [[Ruugia system/Legends|Ruugia]], and [[Trebela system/Legends|Trebela systems]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Locations==
The Gerhalt and Trebela [[Star system/Legends|systems]]<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the terrestrial astronomical objects named [[Gerhalt III]]<ref name="Gamer2">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref> and [[Trebela]], respectively,<ref name="Sourcebook2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> and the Altier system contained the celestial body of the [[Altier|same name]].<ref name="Journal5">{{JournalCite|5|Stand and Deliver}}</ref> The Ruugia system was the origin point of the [[Ruugian noodle]]s.<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ruugian noodle]]s|system=[[Ruugia system/Legends|Ruugia system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

[[File:GamorGSW.png|thumb|right|200px|The Altier sector's Gerhalt system was a part of the Galactic Republic as early as 17,000 BBY.]]
The Gerhalt system was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[17,000 BBY]]. From that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> until [[3996 BBY]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the system to the [[Surron system/Legends|Surron]] and [[Tarmidia system/Legends|Tarmidia systems]]; however, the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist by [[3960 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Trebela was ruled by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kraxith]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A major [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] network operated in Trebela's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] at that [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="Sourcebook2" /> and it was comprised of several Rebel groups that operated independently of each other, with no group being aware of the others' activities<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|261|Trebela}}</ref> or identities. Kraxith eventually broke up the network.<ref name="Sourcebook2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Altier sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the Altier sector was illustrated on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid square O-13.<ref name="Expansion" />
